purpose: Teach: 後述/費やす/沿う/起点/厳正/一味/ナマ/言い換え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の方針は後述する別紙の通り進めろ
lines.en: Proceed according to the attached policy document, as outlined below.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Clipped attack on the opening word. No warmth — this is instruction, not discussion. Steady eye contact, slight forward lean of authority. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業に予算を費やす計画です
lines.en: Understood. We're planning to allocate budget toward the new business venture.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgement, not obsequious. Steady, clear delivery. Slight pause after the affirmation, as if gathering the next thought. Professional but not stiff — he's competent and knows it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様のご要望に沿う製品を作れ
lines.en: Create products that align with our valued clients' requirements.
lines.style: Clipped, instructional. Light emphasis on 「align」 — this is the pivot point. No elaboration; the assumption is the team understands. Mid-range volume, no theatricality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトの起点を明確にしろ
lines.en: Make sure the project's starting point is clearly defined.
lines.style: Firm command softened only slightly by professionalism. The stress lands on 「starting point」 — clarity matters here. Tempo doesn't rush; he's allowing the weight to settle. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員評価は厳正に行います
lines.en: Understood. We'll conduct staff evaluations with full rigor and fairness.
lines.style: Affirmation with substance. Not defensive — he's showing he understands the standard being set. Steady pace. Slight warmth underneath the professionalism, as if confirming he takes this as seriously as the boss does.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の一味と組まないように注意しろ
lines.en: Be careful not to get involved with our competitors or their associates.
lines.style: Warning delivered as quiet instruction. Slight weight on 「careful」 — this is about integrity, not paranoia. Controlled, almost conversational in tone, which makes it heavier. The look that follows matters more than the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料はナマの数字で報告しろ
lines.en: Report the data to us using raw numbers, nothing embellished.
lines.style: Short, unadorned delivery. Emphasis on 「raw」 — this is about honesty. No room for interpretation. Clipped rhythm, no trailing softeners. The expectation is clear and non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。難しい用語は言い換えて社外に伝えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll rephrase technical terms when communicating externally.
lines.style: Confirmation that shows he's thought ahead. Calm, forward-looking. A small nod of competence — he's already anticipating the next step. Professional warmth, not deferential.
